provenance.source: JPL Horizons osculating elements; ESA/RMOC measured pole in the Cheops frame.
provenance.qualification: Computed 67P Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose. ESA/RMOC MTP019 measured nucleus shape, simplified for display. Neutral gray is a model material, not a photograph or an albedo map. The measured north pole is retained; rotational phase is arbitrary. Solar geometry uses the shared 3 September 2026 epoch.
